name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: An implementation of the MacOS terminal. Useful for showcasing a command line interface.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AnimatedSpan, Terminal, TerminalTypingAnimation } from '@/components/ui/terminal'
</script>

<template>
  <Terminal>
    <TerminalTypingAnimation>npx shadcn-vue@latest init</TerminalTypingAnimation>
    <AnimatedSpan>✔ Preflight checks.</AnimatedSpan>
    <AnimatedSpan>✔ Validating Tailwind CSS.</AnimatedSpan>
    <TerminalTypingAnimation>Success! Project initialization completed.</TerminalTypingAnimation>
  </Terminal>
</template>

examples.name: terminal-demo
examples.title: Sequenced
examples.description: Each line starts when the previous one finishes — no delays needed.

examples.name: terminal-delays
examples.title: Custom delays
examples.description: Turn `sequence` off and give every line its own `delay`.

props.name: sequence
props.description: Play the lines one after another: each `TerminalTypingAnimation` / `AnimatedSpan` starts when the previous one finishes.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Start the sequence when the terminal scrolls into view.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The terminal lines: `TerminalTypingAnimation` and `AnimatedSpan` components, in order.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds before the line fades in. Only used when the terminal's `sequence` is off.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Wait until the line is in view. Only used when the terminal's `sequence` is off.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds before typing starts. Only used when the terminal's `sequence` is off.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Wait until the line is in view. Only used when the terminal's `sequence` is off.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The text to type. Plain text only — markup inside is flattened to its text. Named `TypingAnimation` in Magic UI; renamed so it doesn't clash with the standalone Typing Animation component.
